title: Part Fifteen: Housing, Land and Infrastructure

sections.brief: Israel: ILA manages 93% (state, JNF, Development Authority), 49/98-year leases, 1960 laws and JNF's 10 of 22 council seats, 2009 reform; JNF 13%, Ka'adan 2000, Mazuz 2005 and the land swap, Admissions Committees Law 2011 upheld 5-4 (2014, not ripe); Arab towns (139 localities on <3% of land, 13,000 vs 7,000 homes, 97% of demolition orders 2012-14), Kaminitz Law 5 April 2017, 46 unrecognised villages (2018), Resolutions 922/550 and the 2023-25 cuts; US: federal 28% of land (CRS 2024), Euclid 1926, single-family zoning shares, upzoning 2018-2025. Figures: time; compare

US homeownership 65.0% Q2 2026 (peak 69.2% 2004; white 74.5%, Black 45.4%; under-35 35.2%); renter burden; PIT homelessness 2007-2025 (647,258 / 549,928 / 653,104 / 771,480 / 745,652) and HUD's stated Housing First position; Israel public housing 60,000 to 53,000 (2014-19), sales vs purchases, 31-month wait; Mehir Lamishtaken/Matara lottery 2022; Israeli homelessness 2,250-3,470 (2020); northern displacement. Figures: stats; compare

Water: Mekorot, Water Authority, desalination plants 2005-2025 (35% of drinking water 2014, 86% 2022), reuse, 1995 Interim Agreement supply to Palestinians; electricity mix (Israel gas 71%, coal 52%->14%, renewables 14% 2024, missed 2025 target; US 2025 gas 41%, nuclear 18%, coal 17%, renewables 24%); climate policy (Paris exits 2020 and 2026, IRA; Israel's draft Climate Law, OECD 2023); US CO2 per capita 2000-2024 (Israel not separable in EDGAR); transit (Comptroller Dec 2025 metro report, Red Line 2023; ASCE 2025 grades); disasters (FEMA Review Council May 2026; Israel's northern evacuation and Property Tax Fund). Figures: time; compare
